slides.texte_overlay:
conversation starters for
people who hate small talk

"what's the best thing that
happened to you this week?"

"what are you obsessed
with right now?"

"what did you want to be
when you were ten?"

"what's a film you'd make
everyone watch?"

"what's something you changed
your mind about this year?"

"if you could live in any city,
in any century, where
and when?"

and always bring one of your own:
a strange fact, a painting,
a moment in history.
